errors.text_span: Notably, the Ours model outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it on GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, and MT-Bench.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for two of the listed benchmarks. For MMLU, the LLaMA-3-8B-it model (blue bar) has a slightly higher score than the 'Ours' model (orange bar). For MBPP, the scores are nearly identical, so claiming one 'outperforms' the other is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: However, LLaMA-3-8B-it performs better on LC AlpacaEval-2 and Chat-Arena-Hard.
errors.evidence: This statement is entirely incorrect. For both LC AlpacaEval-2 and Chat-Arena-Hard, the 'Ours' model (orange bar) has a higher score than the LLaMA-3-8B-it model (blue bar). The description states the exact opposite of what the chart shows.
